Interface StructBinder<T>

All Superinterfaces:
DataMapping<StructLayout>, GroupBinder<StructLayout, T>, GroupMapping<StructLayout>, Mapping<StructLayout>
public non-sealed interface StructBinder<T> extends GroupBinder<StructLayout, T>
The binder class for struct interfaces.

Struct binder implementations can be created using the builder returned by ffmStruct.
